FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
Every exit chains brake, gear, motor-off, and locked pocketed key against rollaways [A01].
Why it matters: group exit-drill; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
Highway stops land fully off pavement with flashers lit, and children stay clear of live lanes [A01].
Why it matters: group highway-park; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A01
Angle entries scan, signal, clear the rear, and steer sharply centered [A01].
Why it matters: group angle-enter; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A01
Angle exits creep with horn taps and halt at the sightline for final all-around checks [A01].
Why it matters: group angle-exit; difficulty medium; prereq sec09-F03; confusables sec09-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A02
Parallel runs stage two feet out, swing full left to eighteen inches curbside, then full right and center [A02].
Why it matters: group parallel-steps; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A02
Crowds graze bumpers, wide gaps strand, late lefts strike curbs, and fronts swing opposite [A02].
Why it matters: group parallel-errors; difficulty medium; prereq sec09-F05; confusables sec09-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A02
Hills park parallel within six inches, braced, braked, geared, and switched off [A02].
Why it matters: group hill-prep; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A03
Downhill aims at curbs, uphill-with-curb aims away, and uphill-without aims right to flee traffic [A03].
Why it matters: group bracing; difficulty high; prereq sec09-F07; confusables sec09-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A03
Hill starts chain motor, gear, signal, looks, brake release, and opening claims behind through priority [A03].
Why it matters: group hill-start; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A04
Mirror permits travel with disabled drivers or riders on physician proof, and fraud earns a misdemeanor [A04].
Why it matters: group placard; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F10 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A04

Why it matters: group bans; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F11 [A04].
